text:
liz: thinking we should add a tiny "who changed" button on routing policy header — shows actor/time/one-line diff + export CTA
omar: yep. two engineering needs: a fast read API for the pill (<200ms) and an async export job for full history
neha: PII rules up front: UI shows resolved human display names; exports follow tenant redaction_mode (raw|pseudonymize|redact). pseudonymize -> stable pseudonyms, not emails
ui-ux: panel sketch: actor / when / compact diff / Export CTA. before submitting show estimated rows & size
liz: API shapes proposal: GET /v1/audit/policy/{id}/latest -> quick panel data; POST /v1/audit/exports {filters, redaction_mode, reason, preview?} -> job id
omar: quota model suggestion: preview cache (last 24h) cheap quota + full-export sliding quota per tenant + concurrency cap per org
platform-bot: queued export job: id=job-991, est_size=4MB, ETA~45s, presigned_link_ttl=7d
neha: compliance note: export bundle = NDJSON + separate manifest.json. manifest must include actor_resolution_trace, redaction_mode, requester, request_ts, kms_key_id, and truncated_flags
liz: rollout plan: internal 2w -> alpha opt-in for Dedicated -> GA. RFC will include endpoints, manifest schema, quota rules and telemetry events
ui-ux: will mock the pill + panel and share screenshots tomorrow
liz: thanks all — I'll draft RFC and ping for reviews
